notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Changes:

- German language
- French language
- Spanish language
- names of pubs
- you can change the name of the boss
- names of saved files
- you can change the frequency of autosave
- notes for beer batches 
- female names for employees

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I'm happy to announce that update 1.1 is now available!

Changes:

- detailed statistics of drunk beer for each pub
- chance to brew high-quality beer by auto-brewing mode is increased
- trends in the beer market are available
- periodic tax policy changes are available
- periodic changes in ingredient prices are available
- some changes in the texts
- found bugs are fixed
- work schedule for the employees (automation of most works)

notes.title: New languages and update are coming soon
notes.content:
I am currently working on German, French and Spanish localizations. They will be available soon.

After that, I'm going to make a small update that will add more customization and automation to the game.
